title: A graph-aware bounded distance decoder for all stabilizer codes
summary: We formulate a bounded distance decoding strategy applicable to all stabilizer codes including both CSS and non-CSS code-families. The framework emerges out of the local Clifford equivalence between arbitrary stabilizer states and graph states. Using the graphical representation of the stabilizers and the syndromes, we constitute the bounded distance decoding as an adaptable generalization of maximum likelihood decoding, ensuring correction of all errors with weights upper bounded by a target weight.
